nodes.label: Video Studio (unified local-first app)
nodes.rationale: One Flask app (port 5180) unifying subtitle removal, transcripts, dubbing, lip-sync repair, captions, QA, exports and the Ads Factory. Design intent: engines (subtitle-studio, autoVSL, dubbing-studio) are called in place, never copied; config.json is the single file holding every machine path; jobs are persistent, resumable and GPU-arbitrated; the original standalone apps remain untouched fallbacks.

nodes.label: DubSync Repair Engine (remux/refit/renorm/relipsync)
nodes.rationale: Exists so a finished dub can be fixed locally for free instead of paying for a cloud re-dub; every repair lands as a new take and the current final is never overwritten.

nodes.label: Video Studio Shared UI Shell (vs.css + vs-nav.js)
Video Studio Job Store API (/api/job, /api/jobs)
nodes.rationale: Persistent + resumable + GPU-arbitrated job store (app/jobs.py); every long-running tab operation returns a job_id which the UI polls for lines/progress/status/cost, so jobs survive server restarts.

nodes.label: ProPainter Video Inpainting
nodes.rationale: AI engine behind subtitle erasing — rebuilds the video behind burned-in captions chunk by chunk instead of blurring or black-boxing; a classic inpaint fallback is used when it is unavailable.

nodes.label: Local Whisper Transcription
nodes.rationale: Free local GPU transcription used for transcripts, dubbing scripts, and word-timed captions.

hyperedges.label: Video Studio 11-tab UI on shared shell (vs.css + vs-nav.js)
Dub production pipeline: clean → script → dub → repair → captions → export → clone
